summary: 完成 Batch 016 定义的 pre-publish release-candidate scope。既有 exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1 隔离验收、官方 DSH 生命周期、/image-mind 路由、浏览器设置/插件面、deterministic local main/vision model-only understand_image tool-call、8/9 限制、重启恢复、隐私边界、focused guard tests、官方 remove/cleanup 与最终 PR CI 均已通过。npm 发布、post-publish registry install、未授权 hosted-provider quality、tag/release 及真实 Harness 安装仅作为未来人工授权事项记录，不属于本 Result 的 required tests。

tests.evidence: Revised ACTIVE_TASK validated; origin/main LATEST resolved to 7a1d96b and was merged non-destructively as 5ae2f6f on feat/final-rc-closure-batch-016.

tests.name: PR #58 review checkpoint
tests.evidence: Public GitHub API confirmed PR #58 head 002dad6 is open, Draft, and unmerged; no new PR was created and no merge was performed.

tests.name: runtime identity and isolation
tests.evidence: Windows 10.0.22631 x64; Node v24.18.1; npm 11.16.0; pnpm 11.7.0; exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1. The run used a task-owned temporary DSH_HOME, profile web, persisted task-owned state, and alternate free listener port 43116; the pre-existing 3080 listener (PID 8180) remained untouched.

tests.evidence: Repository-built 0.2.0 vision and image-mind tarballs were installed through official dsh plugin add. The task-owned pnpm override was used only to bridge the unpublished @ran-sh/dsh-vision@^0.2.0 dependency. --dump-config on web composed web-app/webserver, vision-runtime, and image-mind.

tests.name: fresh exact rc.1 boot and route handlers
tests.evidence: Official exact rc.1 web boot announced http://127.0.0.1:43116; GET / and GET /image-mind/catalog returned HTTP 200. The host route set also returned the expected guarded responses for previews/settings/raw paths.

tests.name: real browser rc.1 acceptance
tests.evidence: agent-browser loaded the task-owned 43116 UI, completed notice/API-key-later onboarding, opened 设置→插件→图像理解, showed the image-mind configuration card and neutral defaults, and the 插件列表 showed vision/plugin-image-mind plus webserver/web-app as mounted and enabled.

tests.name: deterministic local main/vision tool-call path
tests.evidence: A task-owned keyless OpenAI-compatible stub served both main-stub and vision-stub. session.models reported current local-main/main-stub as routable; an uploaded and committed one-image batch was sent through session.prompt; history recorded an assistant understand_image tool call sourced from local-main/main-stub, the vision stub received one image payload, and the final assistant answer was the deterministic stub marker.

tests.name: model-only routing and neutral attachment boundary
tests.evidence: Fresh focused image-mind tests passed the text-only send-hook route, neutral attachment marker, tool selection and source redaction seams. The model request selected local-main/main-stub while image bytes were consumed only by understand_image/vision-stub.

tests.name: eight-image guard and ninth rejection
tests.evidence: Fresh focused sweep (7 files, 21 tests) passed send-hook-image-limit: exactly 8 proceeds with the neutral marker and the ninth is rejected before upload/preview/prompt side effects; send-hook routing and privacy tests passed in the same run.

tests.name: restart recovery
tests.evidence: After stopping and restarting exact rc.1 on the same task-owned home, /image-mind/previews returned the previously committed batch with count only, and session.models/history remained available. No task-owned attachment ids or private paths were recorded in this Result Contract.

tests.name: privacy and call/debug redaction
tests.evidence: Browser settings exposed no credentials, raw URLs, attachment ids or route diagnostics; preview responses exposed only batchId/count/updatedAt; tool-call-view-redaction, session-history-routing, raw/preview restart and system-prompt routing tests passed. No secret value was read or logged.

tests.name: repository/package gates
tests.evidence: Fresh npm test passed vision 63, image-mind 325 with 8 intentional skips, and root 57; npm run typecheck and npm run build passed. The package/built integrity lanes were included in the passing root suite (11 package and 6 built-artifact tests).

tests.name: official remove and isolated cleanup
tests.evidence: Official dsh plugin remove completed for task profiles web and smoke; subsequent dumps contained no vision-runtime/image-mind layer. Browser/processes/stub were closed, ports 43116/43117 were free, and the exact task-owned temporary tree was deleted. The real Harness and port 3080 were not modified.

tests.name: final PR #58 CI
tests.evidence: GitHub Actions CI run 32584181057 for current PR head 002dad6e965a1e43b74b033170f47dc604a1f680 completed success. Required jobs install-roundtrip, windows, test (22), test (24), and secret-scan each completed success; PR #58 remained open, Draft, and unmerged.

notes: No dsh-vision defect was reproduced in the corrected official web profile; the earlier no-listener observation came from booting a custom base-only smoke profile, not from the product route implementation.

All acceptance evidence uses task-owned deterministic stubs and safe identifiers only; no Harness-owned settings, credentials, cookies, node_modules, pnpm store, or real 3080 process were read or changed.
PR #58 is the only continuation target and remains Draft/open/unmerged for ChatGPT review.
